_comment: Environment profile: Project A, F5 Agentic AI Autopilot. Not editable from the Control Center UI. Destinations must be pinned in sim_profiles.APPROVED['project-a']. No secret values here: TLS material and S3 credentials are referenced by ENVIRONMENT VARIABLE NAME only.
label: Project A · Agentic AI Autopilot (BIG-IP_C)
summary: Fraud-investigation agents (A2A + MCP) delivered and secured by BIG-IP_C (tenant AP_AI).
network: BIG-IP_C VIPs live on the isolated agent network 10.50.10.0/24 (no uplink). Workloads that call VIPs must run on a host attached to that network; the Mac reaches only the management LAN 192.0.2.0/24. Project A and Project B networks are never connected.

client_identity.note: Dedicated simulator identity (certificate CN). Not provisioned: needs (1) a client certificate signed by the lab CA and (2) an Autopilot validation_identities entry followed by a Security-package redeploy through the Autopilot approval workflow. The validator identity ap-validator must not be reused: it shares the 120 req/min per-identity window that Autopilot's security.rate_limited test consumes.

A2A_VIP.note: Server TLS only (no client certificate). Agent A calls it during investigations; pa_a2a_card performs A2A discovery through it.

MCP_RISK_VIP.note: 2 replicas, least-connections, Mcp-Session-Id persistence; AI Security policy iRule (identity allow-list, 120 req/min per identity).

AGENT_A_API.note: Entry point only. Agent A then calls Agent B through A2A_VIP and Agent B calls the MCP VIPs; the investigation result's card_url proves whether the BIG-IP front door was used.

S3_VIP.note: AI Data Delivery (deployment f7c281be): http_ai + stats_s3 (signed/unsigned, 2xx/4xx, bytes), pool SeaweedFS 10.50.20.41:8333, SNAT automap. Reads are SigV4-signed with credentials from the environment.

RAG_VIP.note: AI Data Delivery: pool Qdrant 10.50.20.40:6333. Read-only collection info and points/query only.

INFERENCE_VIP.note: AI Data Delivery: pool Ollama 10.50.20.45:11434 (single CPU inference host shared with Agent B and fraud-intel). Embeddings and small chat completions only; guarded by activity_guard.

activity_guard._note: LLM workloads (defer_while_investigating) skip a run while the fraud application is in use: the most recent investigation finished < quiet_s ago, or Agent A cannot be read (fail closed). Agent A records an investigation when it finishes, so a single in-flight investigation is not visible; the overlap is bounded by max_tokens and the hourly caps.

budgets.note: Per-instance per-minute budgets below; per-workload hourly caps on each workload. BIG-IP_C rate limit is 120 req/min per identity; the simulator stays far below it.

pa_lab.label: Project A traffic generator (AP-AUTOPILOT-01 container)
pa_lab.placement: Isolated container ap-trafficgen on AP-AUTOPILOT-01 (agent0 10.50.10.5 on-link to the VIPs; management 192.0.2.60 reaches Agent A). The host also has backend0 10.50.20.5: direct backend access is refused by the pinned allow-list (FORBIDDEN_DIRECT), never by routing. Not deployed (Phase 2 is offline).

pa_mac.label: Mac (management LAN)
pa_mac.placement: This Mac; reaches Agent A and Autopilot on 192.0.2.0/24 only (Project A launchd job not installed).

pa_mcp_delivery._note: One MCP session per run on one VIP: initialize (version negotiation) -> notifications/initialized -> tools/list -> one read-only tools/call -> session DELETE.

pa_mcp_authz._note: Deny probe targets MCP_RISK_VIP, whose server does not implement freeze_account: even if the policy failed open nothing could change. Unauthenticated probe = no client certificate (TLS rejection or 401 expected).

pa_mcp_rate_burst.reason: BIG-IP_C allows 120 requests/min per identity. Proving the limit needs at least 121 requests inside one calendar minute, above the simulator's hard budget of 60/min. Autopilot Validate (security.rate_limited) already proves it with its own identity.

pa_agent_investigation._note: Disabled by default: each run creates an investigation record in Agent A and drives LLM work (owner guidance: at most 5 investigations per minute).

pa_training_data_read._note: Disabled: bucket and synthetic shards do not exist yet (Phase 3 seed).

pa_llm_inference._note: Disabled: superseded by pa_chat_small (the OpenAI-compatible call Agent B makes, activity-guarded, smaller cap).

pa_a2a_card._note: A2A discovery through the A2A VIP (verified TLS, no client certificate). Creates no task and no LLM work.

pa_chat_small._note: Disabled in the initial profile (owner decision): run only on explicit selection (--only pa_chat_small). Same model as Agent B (already loaded: no model swap). 16 tokens max, non-streaming, at most 4 per hour.

telemetry.note: Project A has no simulator telemetry collector yet: results go to the status file and the run log only. BIG-IP_C counters are read by Autopilot through the deployer.

metric_sources.simulator: Measured by the simulator client (status file + run log): outcomes, latency, bytes, MCP negotiation, HTTP status.
metric_sources.bigip: Not read by the simulator. BIG-IP_C counters are read by Autopilot through the deployer (read-only).
metric_sources.application: Agent A investigation result fields (state, front-door card_url, replicas) as returned by Agent A's API.
